snippet.title: CODE VEIN II — Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
If time were a weapon to wield, could you undo the sins of ruin?
Bound By Blood, Revenants gather once more – CODE VEIN II is coming in 2026. Wishlist now on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam!

Learn more at https://playcodevein.com

#CODEVEIN
